checks.name: orientation and sampled-fold evidence
checks.evidence: Each selected element is inspected at its ten reference nodes plus center. A consistent negative orientation is allowed; evidenced positive/negative determinant reversal rejects it. These eleven samples and accepted-root regularity do not prove whole-element/global injectivity. The root-confirmed implementation must collect all eleven samples before classification: the fixed r-2r^2 fold has zero center J but positive/negative nodal signs, so invalid_geometry takes precedence over a center-only invalid_jacobian. The planar singular case has no regular sign reversal and remains invalid_jacobian.

checks.name: outside versus unresolved
checks.evidence: Only queries beyond the complete conservative whole-CAD bounds are certified outside in this recipe. Failures return diagnostics/no field, never nearest, extrapolated or valid zero output. Newton iterates may leave the reference domain; their Jacobian sign alone is not evidence of an interior fold.
